wards.name: the sealed neck
wards.denied: The passage narrows to one man's width and somebody has filled it with a slab of fused stone. Break it, or hold the warden's key, and not otherwise.
wards.opened: The slab comes apart and the heat behind it comes out all at once.

spots.line: Past the neck the floor is glass, and the glass has things set in it.
Everything burnt from one side. All of it facing the same way.
Spears stacked in a rack, and the shafts are gone and the heads are still there.
Ash, ankle deep, and no wind in here to move it.
The last clean air. People stop and take some before they go on.

chests.line: A footlocker, scorched to the bands but shut, which is the only reason it is still worth opening.
Coin run together into a lump and prised apart again by somebody patient.
Past the neck, in the glass, where nothing has walked since it cooled.

people.name: Cass the Ashwarden
chatter: It burned for nine days. Nobody lit it and nobody put it out.
Everything past the neck is still warm. It has been still warm for a lifetime.
Breathe through cloth. I am not being dramatic.
You will come out grey. Everyone comes out grey.

people.name: Tobrin, counting them out
chatter: Names on the way in. Names on the way out. I compare them at dusk.
Do not tell me you will be quick. They all say quick.
There is water at the post. Take some. It costs nothing.
